display_long_description:
# 📻 The Theremin, Reborn in Mixed Reality 🎵

Put on your headset, flip the switch, and play. A real instrument floats before you — responsive, expressive, and endlessly tunable.

✨ New in Version 1.1

- Hand tracking greatly improved, closer to a real theremin where subtle finger movements matter.
- New reverb acoustically modeled from a cathedral

👻 Ghost Hands Add-On

Record your hand movements and perform alongside your past self. Layer phrases, build harmonies, or turn your room into a haunted chamber orchestra.

🎛️ Shape Your Sound

Adjust knobs: point your controller, pull the trigger, then turn — or pull outward and orbit for more precision.

- Amplitude Curve – shape how your left hand controls volume 
- Timbre – from pure sine wave to rich violin tones 
- Reverb – simulated room acoustics surround you with sound 
- Number of Octaves – define your instrument’s range 
- Lowest frequency – from deep bass to sparkling highs

🎻 Designed for Expression
- Linear pitch spacing – equal distance between notes
- Pitch hologram – a luminous ruler showing where notes live
- Adjustable reach – move the low note closer or farther away
- Touch Controller precision – stable optical tracking, no “magic electromagnetic circle” required 💫

🌈 Beyond Western Tuning

Perfect for experimental musicians, sound magicians, and anyone working on their gamakas.

Record or stream with the Horizon OS camera, connect to speakers or your DAW, and use Seamless Multitasking to play along with YouTube karaoke or backing tracks.
